reading:
Judged four times (main rounds 11, 12 and 13, and tour round 1). The lineage peaked with Switchboard, Trued: 7.84, #2 of 14 in heat b, in 7 top fours with 6 promise votes, and +0.41 on Joined. The system lens gave it 8.2 and the type lens 8.0, calling it the most codified system of the heat: one contents line (lamp, number, name, dotted leader, count) is every head and every row, and every inner page opens as one module beside a register. Usability gave 8.0 ('the best way around the whole app'). Soul gave 8.5 ('the most of the original's own effect'): 'What's the plan?' is typed on scanlined glass over a block-cursor well, and each page has its own green screen.

WHAT THE JUDGES LOVE, in every round:
- Home as the map of every page, with counts and lamps: the best 'where is everything' device of the tournament.
- The question typed on the glass.
- The contents line, with leaders to right-aligned tabular facts.
- Settings as a contents register, with the part that needs a look first.
- To do's bar-chart screen with 'Next due'.
- Bone in place of brass, and section colour as a thin cap.

WHAT SANK THE EARLIER VERSIONS, all fixed by Trued: a brown case, VT323 heads off the glass, pastel tiles, the nav moved to a foot key row, tracked-caps keys, half-empty stretched cells, card lists and a 3.5k Home.

WHAT STILL HOLDS TRUED BACK:
1. The whole question glows, so 'plan' is not the one lit word, and _ask.html still says 'mind' (feedback, soul, system, type).
2. Green share is 64%, with the lowest hue variety of the refinements, and the tube is the size of a panel (feedback, system, skeptic).
3. Home is a wall of equal boxes that stretch (Memory, Wishes, Status's columns), with no second tier (feedback, style, system, interaction, usability).
4. On Ideas the radar starts at about y=740, below the first screen (five lenses).
5. Page numbers (990, 998) off the map read as costume (interaction, usability, skeptic).
6. The composer is split between the glass and a grey tray, and three links come before the textarea (interaction, usability, soul).
7. Eyebrows and column heads are tracked mono caps (type).
8. The section caps include pink and lilac (feedback, the owner's lens).
9. The inner pages are near-copies of Desk Terminal's column with the same hash-bar glass (skeptic).
10. 'Today' on the month is a heavy steel block (system, skeptic).

WHAT WOULD MAKE IT WIN: keep every loved device and make the light scarcer and truer.
- One hot word on a smaller glass.
- Each page's screen moved to where it says what the rows cannot: at the head of the register, not under the filters.
- Home in two tiers, with the household's pages set as a true contents list.
- Page numbers only where they index.
- Grounded, cool colour carried into the lines and figures, not the caps.
- Figures keyed to the rows they draw.

Lit Manual (8.02) beat it in heat b by joining figure to content: its NOW line crosses the list. The switchboard's answer is to tie its screens and its radar to its own rows.

briefs.name: Switchboard, Settled
briefs.hypothesis:
Trued lost to Lit Manual on faults the judges named precisely, not on its idea. The same system with those faults fixed should beat 7.84:
- One hot word on a glass half the height (soul 8.5 kept, green share down from 64% toward about 40%).
- Next up and its radar as the Plans cell's own green screen, so the textarea is the first stop after the nav and the question no longer reads as the heading of Next up.
- Home in two tiers, with the household's pages as one true contents list.
- Every inner page's screen at the head of its register, where it is on the first screen and no longer copies Desk Terminal's column.
- Page numbers only on the map, where they index.
- Sentence-case labels, and a cool set in place of pink and lilac.
That answers every lens's top fix and keeps every device that scored.
briefs.brief:
Copy t1-switchboard-refine (palette tour/t2-b/palettes/t1-switchboard-refine.json, variants/t1-switchboard-refine/). Keep its idea, rack, contents line, bone and graphite, faces and mood. Change only the following.

SYSTEM (every page)
- PALETTE:
  - ideas #bc97e8 becomes #a8b0ea (steel periwinkle, h≈278, C≈.08).
  - shows #eda6c1 becomes #c9aac4, used only as the Show kind's word.
  - Keep: plans #9ccdf8 (cyan-sky), todo #83d5d4 (teal), accent/bone #cdc6b5, people #eaa76b (setup and needs-a-look only), brand/screen exactly #6dff9c, glow, screenGlow and topGlow all 1.0.
  - In sheet.css, `.in-wishes, .to-wishes { --sec: var(--bone) }`. The cool trio (Plans, To do, Ideas) is the only section colour, and everything else is bone.
- CAPS: the 2px coloured cap stays on Home's three list cells (Plans, To do, Ideas) and on each inner page's plate. Every other cell gets a 1px bone hairline at 35%.
- LABELS: `--t-label` becomes 0.8125rem IBM Plex Sans 600, sentence case, no tracking, in --label. Apply it to label, legend, .cell-label, .strip, .fig-unit, .keys-name, table.data th/caption, table.month th, dl.facts dt, .waiting-cell h3 and .section-links a. So: 'After Next up', 'Lately added', 'Show', 'Kind', 'Search', 'The lights', 'Who', 'Due', 'By kind of call', 'What for', 'Calls', 'US$', and the form's 'Title', 'Kind' and so on. Caps stay only as inverse legends on the glass. Plex Mono is for dates, times and figures in fixed columns.
- STEPS: add `--t-cell-1: 1.625rem` (26px, semi-condensed 600) for the tier-one names (Vera's plate, Plans, To do, Ideas). The sommaire's lines use `--t-item` (19px). One count pattern everywhere: a condensed 1.5rem numeral, then its word in --t-small dim: '5 coming', '4 open · 2 late' (numerals one size, '2 late' an amber link to /tasks), '12 saved', '0 open', '4 people', '9 parts · 1 needs a look'.
- PAGE NUMBERS: they stay only on Home's map, as the sommaire's index (12px Plex Mono in --label). Remove them from:
  - the bar's current key ('Home 100' becomes 'Home' with its lit LED);
  - every plate (.plate-no);
  - the chat plate;
  - Settings' rows (991-999).
- ROW AFTERGLOW: replace the invisible 12% steel `--row-wash` with the lit edge that registers. On :hover or :focus-within, `box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--lit), 0 0 18px -10px var(--lit)`, on in var(--glow-in) and fading over var(--afterglow). Never amber.
- BAR: `background: rgb(8 11 10 / .86); backdrop-filter: blur(6px)`, so E6's 7.5% haze shows as a green breath under it.
- MODEL NAMES: wherever one shows, use `replace('-', '‑')` (non-breaking hyphen), so 'gpt‑6‑luna' never breaks.
- TARGETS: every target at least 2.75rem, with 0 small targets on Home. Check the whole Tab order on desktop and phone.

HOME (home.html; `.map`)
- LAYOUT at 64rem and up: `grid-template-columns: minmax(0,7fr) minmax(0,5fr); grid-template-areas: 'term setup' 'term plans' 'todo plans' 'ideas service'; align-items: start; grid-auto-rows: min-content`.
  - DOM order: terminal, setup, plans, todo, ideas, service.
  - Cells end at their content: remove `.map-col > :last-child{flex:1}` and all stretching.
  - If the spans leave more than about 40px of dead slate, fall back to two flex columns: [terminal, To do, Ideas] and [Setup, Plans, the service].
  - Target Home at 2300px or less.
- TERMINAL (page 200). `.minitel` stays graphite with a 2-3px bezel ring round the glass, not a slab.
  - Plate line: her screen glyph (E19), '200', 'Vera' (plain text at --t-cell-1, NOT a link, so the textarea is the first stop after the nav), the day (15px dim) and the power LED (E12).
  - The glass holds only her side of the conversation:
    - If talk.line: her last line, one line of VT323 at --t-tube-s, dim strength, not a link.
    - The question (see title), then the prompt line: the VT323 '>' with a bloom (text-shadow 0 0 8px brand 60%), then a bounded well (1px edge at 30% phosphor, #07110b fill). The well's text is Plex Sans 17px in bone, never VT323. Caret in brand, E4's resting halo, and on focus a brand edge, a 3px ring and a 22-30px bloom.
    - The glass is sized to its content, 13rem tall or less.
  - The deck (From with its select, 'Send where I am' with a 44px hit, the mic, Send) is the glass's own base bezel inside the same case. There is no separate grey tray and no rule between glass and deck, so field and button are one control. Send is E3: brand fill, a 1px ring and an 8px pool, brighter on hover, fading after.
  - Under the deck, the three ways to start are keys with a bone '→' before the words: 44px, 8px gap, no boxed digits.
  - If talk.line, 'Continue with Vera →' goes on the case foot, after the starters.
  - E7: the deck's lip is lit from the glass above (a radial pool of 12% brand, with scanlines masked to it), and the case spills a 60-80px pool onto the page below (0 40px 70px -40px, brand 35%).
  - E16 power-on from a line, starting at opacity .05.
- SETUP CELL, while it has steps: a contents line (amber bar lamp, 'Finish setting up', leader, '3 left'). The steps are rows with plain amber mono numerals '1', '2', '3' (not boxed) and their links, then the foot line. Slate body with a 2px amber top cap, never an olive or amber fill.
- PLANS CELL (400, sky cap):
  - Contents line: a lamp lit when a plan is today, '400', 'Plans' at --t-cell-1, the leader, '5 coming'.
  - Then its own green screen, moved here from the terminal: `.crt.next-up` sized to its content.
    - Words at left: the NEXT UP inverse legend padded 1ch; the title bright, as a link to its idea (underlined 2px, inverse on hover as E15); 'Thu 1 Oct, 10:00 [TOMORROW]' with .rel bright; the place, dim.
    - At right, the radar at 9.5rem with the full E17: blip halos, hot cores, the next one pinging, an 8s sweep, and ring labels at 55%.
    - Drop '4 more on the radar'.
  - Then 'After Next up' (13px semibold) and the four one-line rows: date in Plex Mono tabular ('Sun  4 Oct'), title 600, leader, time in mono, 'in 4 days' in sky. Then the source note.
- TO DO CELL (500, teal cap): contents line with '4 open · 2 late'. Column heads 'Who' and 'Due' in sentence case. Rows: tick (1.15rem box in a 44px hit; late boxes amber-edged), title, leader, who, and the due words, amber when late ('was due 3 days ago').
- IDEAS CELL (300, periwinkle cap): '12 saved'; 'Lately added'; four rows with the kind icon and kind word in the kind's colour (restaurants clay). Foot: 'Restaurants · 2 to try →' and '+ Add an idea'.
- THE SERVICE CELL: the sommaire's last page, in number order, each line a 2.75rem contents line (h2) with one sub-line:
  - 600 Wishes ··· 0 open, with 'Maya 0 · Theo 0' as links.
  - 700 Memory ··· →, with '+ Tell Vera something'.
  - 800 Family ··· 4 people, with outlined initial tiles S A M T.
  - 900 Status ··· 1 on · 2 off, with '● Answering ○ Telegram ○ Calendar' as lamps with words.
  - 990 Settings ··· 9 parts · 1 needs a look (amber words), with an amber bar lamp and 'Sign-in and security needs a look →'.
  - The lamp key once, at the cell's foot.
  This replaces the Status, Wishes, Memory, Family and nine-row Settings cells.
- PHONE: bar; terminal (question on one line at about 2.25rem, well 3 rows, then From, mic and Send on one row with 'Send where I am' under, then the starters stacked); then setup; Plans (words beside a 7rem radar); To do; Ideas; the service. Tab bar at the foot with the LED on the current key.

INNER PAGES (the rack, `.board`)
- `.side`, the module: the plate (icon in section colour, title at 32px condensed 600, figure and unit on one line, lede at 40ch or less, the one green primary full width), then the page's tools (one bank of 44px latched keys per filter, sentence case, the chosen key steel with its LED).
- `.main`, the register: the page's `.screen-cell` moves here, to the HEAD of the register. It is a wide, short tube, 9.5rem tall or less and sized to its content: VT323 at three strengths, 0.35px blur, scanlines, sheen and vignette, a thin 2-3px bezel, E12 spill and a power LED. It says what the rows do not. The column heads and one-line rows follow.
- Pages with nothing live (Settings, Wishes, Family, Memory, the form) have no screen, and their module is the plate alone.
- IDEAS:
  - Module: plate ('12 saved', '+ Add an idea'), Search, the Kind bank two-up (icon in the kind's colour), More filters.
  - Head screen: the places radar at 8.5rem at left (home at the middle, north up, rings 15m, 45m, 2h), and beside it 'ON THE MAP' inverse, '10 of 12 placed', 'Nearest: {places_radar.nearest.title}, {away}' and 'Furthest: …', from places_radar.count, nearest and furthest, with `nowrap` on the away words.
  - Then the register (#, idea, kind, for, by road with the compass in its own column), then the 'Save a thought for later' fold.
- TO DO:
  - Module: plate ('Things to do', '4 open · 2 late' on one line, '+ Add something to do'), the Show bank, Search.
  - Head screen in two columns: at left the bars 'Late ######## 2', 'This week', 'Later', 'No date' (Late in amber on the glass); at right 'NEXT DUE' inverse, the task and 'Thu 1 Oct, 19:56'.
  - Register: tick, #, title, leader, Who, Due in amber words when late, and 'Edit' as a 44px sentence-case key with a pencil.
- PLANS, month (plans_month.html; List in plans.html likewise):
  - Module: plate ('2 to come'), 'Connect the calendar', the List · Month bank, the source note.
  - Head screen: 'SEPTEMBER 2026' inverse, 'This weekend, 3–4 Oct: Oaks Park roller rink' and, if the weeks give it, 'Next free weekend: 10–11 Oct'. Words only, no hash bars.
  - Month: transparent cells with hairlines and weekend columns shaded at a 60% slate mix. TODAY is no longer a filled block: a 2px steel (#a9c4d8) cap, a 1px steel ring, the numeral in bone 600 and a small lit lamp. Plan chips are bone words on a 2px sky left edge.
- STATUS:
  - Module: plate ('$1.26 in 30 days · 6 calls'), 'Change the limit', the lamp key under a sentence-case 'The lights'.
  - Head screen: 'SPENT TODAY, ABOUT', '$0.00' at --t-tube-xl, '[.............] 0% of the $2.00 daily limit', 'Starts again at midnight'.
  - The three lamp columns each end at their content (align-self: start). Cost tables with sentence-case heads.
- SETTINGS:
  - Plate only: the figure '1 needs a look' as an amber link to its part. No 'How it stands' screen.
  - Register: the parts as contents lines (lamp slot, icon, name 19px 600, leader, how it stands, arrow), needs-a-look first, no numbers.
- CHAT:
  - Module: plate ('Vera' with her glyph, lede) and 'The kids’ conversations' keys.
  - Register: the thread, family on the right with the initial tile and steel edge, Vera on the left in glass lit from its foot.
  - Composer docked in one case: the glass line ('>' lit, block caret, Plex textarea) with Send on the same row, and From, 'Send where I am' and the mic on the case's lip.
- FORM (idea_form.html):
  - Plate: 'Ideas /', 'New idea', lede.
  - Register: one cell of contents lines, each a 9rem label column (Title, Kind, Suggested by, Who it is for, Description) and its bounded field (E4 focus), with help under in 15px dim. No three-up boxes with dead space.
  - The 'Everything else' fold, then 'Add it' (the one E3 primary) and 'Cancel'.

LIGHT
The phosphor list: the mark and its caret (E2), the terminal glass (E13 and E14), 'plan' (E1), the well (E4), Send and one primary per view (E3), focus (E5), lamps that are on breathing (E20), the Plans radar (E17), each head screen (E13-E16), her glyphs (E19), and :target cells flashing and fading over 1.8s (E10, the lineage's own L112). Everything else is matte. Keep the RM, MC and FC blocks.

HARD CHECKS: no inline style, <style> or script; keep every form's csrf and once tokens; drop no sprite icon.
briefs.borrows:
The judges' fixes, most-cited first:
1. 'plan' as the one lit word, with 'What’s the' at the tube's dim strength and 'plan' at the hot core with E1's two-layer halo (feedback, soul, system, type), and the title from one source in _ask.html (feedback, type).
2. Cut the green: a smaller terminal glass, radar about 150-190px, and screens only where something is live, dropping Settings' screen (feedback, soul, system, skeptic).
3. Home in two tiers, cells ending at their content, and Wishes, Memory, Family and Settings sharing one slim contents cell; the Home Settings cell as '9 parts · 1 needs a look' instead of nine rows (feedback, style, system, interaction, usability).
4. The Ideas screen on the first screen (feedback, soul, system, interaction, usability), and the skeptic's 'glass at the head of the register' on every inner page.
5. Page numbers only on Home's map (skeptic, usability, interaction; system, type and style keep them quiet at 12px, which they stay).
6. One-frame composer, with the deck as the tube's base bezel (soul, interaction, usability), and the textarea before any link in Tab order (usability, tour lesson).
7. Sentence-case 13px semibold labels in place of tracked mono caps (type).
8. A cool period set plus bone in place of pink and lilac (feedback).
9. Today as a steel cap and ring, not a block (system, skeptic).
10. 'Edit' as a 44px key (interaction); '4 open · 2 late' on one line and one count pattern (type); non-breaking hyphens in model names (type); Status's columns ending at their content (system); plain numerals for setup and arrow keys for the starters (usability); words, not hash bars, on the Plans screen (usability).

From the phosphor kit: E1, E3, E4, E6 (translucent bar), E7 (pool from the glass onto the case and the page), E10, E12-E17, E19, E20.

One small borrowed device, answering the invisible-afterglow fault: the lit sage row edge from T1-33 / L228 (tour lessons).

It does not take the retired mosaics or the unlabelled lamp matrix, and it leaves the spend meter to the mutant.
briefs.title:
What’s the *plan*? Kept: it is the lineage's best and the tour's standard. It was first or joint first in 13 of 16 title notes, and style, interaction and the skeptic called it 'at its best typed on the switchboard glass', where it reads as the terminal's prompt. The family's own kitchen-table phrase names the whole job (weekends, the calendar, reminders and ideas are all 'the plan'), and at 16 characters it holds one line on a phone. The refinement fixes how it is set, not the words:
- 'What’s the' drops to the tube's dim strength with one tight halo.
- 'plan' alone runs at the hot core (#a9ffc7) with E1's two-layer halo.
- The Plex apostrophe span stays, and a block cursor follows the question mark.
- Next up leaves this glass, so no other glow sits beside the lit word.
- One macro (`ask_title()` in _ui.html) feeds both home.html and _ask.html, so 'mind' is gone for good.

briefs.name: Switchboard, Patched
briefs.hypothesis:
Style's verdict on Trued was 'a wall of equal boxes with coloured caps, and little on Home is drawn'. The skeptic added that its screens repeat their cells. Four gems patched into the switchboard's own circuits answer both, where a clean-up alone would not:
- The circuit's colour in the wiring, not in caps (L014).
- The plan days printed large as the Plans rows' designators (L046, the date shape the owner praised above all).
- The terminal's radar keyed to those rows by the same day numerals, lighting as a row is pointed at (L201).
- Setup cut to one service line (L042).
On top of the lineage's key fixes, Home becomes a drawn, readable map in grounded colour, with one glass on it, its figure touching its rows.
briefs.brief:
Copy t1-switchboard-refine (tour/t2-b/palettes/t1-switchboard-refine.json, variants/t1-switchboard-refine/). The sommaire stays recognisable at a glance: the contents lines with numbers, lamps, leaders and counts, the question typed on the terminal's glass, and every inner page as module plus register.

FIRST, THE LINEAGE'S MOST IMPORTANT FIXES:
- Palette: ideas becomes #a8b0ea and shows becomes #c9aac4 (the Show kind only). Wishes, Vera, Status, Memory, Family and Settings take --sec bone. Brand and screen exactly #6dff9c, the three glows 1.0.
- Labels (label, legend, .cell-label, .strip, .fig-unit, table heads, .keys-name) in 0.8125rem Plex Sans 600, sentence case, untracked.
- Page numbers only on Home's map: none in the bar key, the plates, the chat plate or Settings' rows.
- The textarea is the first stop after the nav.
- The deck is the glass's base bezel in one case.
- Every inner page's `.screen-cell` goes to the head of `.main`, the register (a wide, short tube sized to its content, saying what the rows do not). Settings, Wishes, Family, Memory and the form have no screen.
- Today on the month is a 2px steel cap and ring with a bone numeral.
- 'Edit' is a 44px key. '4 open · 2 late' sits on one line. Model names use `replace('-', '‑')`.
- The bar is translucent (rgb(8 11 10 / .86)) so E6 shows.
- The row afterglow is a lit sage edge (inset 2px var(--lit), fading over var(--afterglow)).
- 0 small targets on Home.

HOME (home.html). Two columns at 64rem and up, `minmax(0,7fr) minmax(0,5fr)`, each a flex column ending at its content, then a full-width foot strip. Target: columns level within about 30px, Home at 2200px or less. DOM order: left column, right column, strip.
- LEFT, TERMINAL (page 200):
  - Plate line: glyph, '200', 'Vera' (plain text, not a link), the day, power LED.
  - The glass, at 48rem and up, is two columns:
    - At left, the radar at 11rem (about 176px) with the full E17: halos, hot cores, the next blip pinging, an 8s sweep. Each blip carries its row's day numeral (see feature 2).
    - At right: her last line at dim strength if there is one (not a link), then the question 'Anything to plan?' (VT323 at 2.6rem, 'Anything to' at dim strength with one tight halo, 'plan' at the hot core #a9ffc7 with E1's halo, a block cursor after the question mark, and the Plex apostrophe span not needed). Under it the prompt line: a lit '>' and a bounded Plex well of 2 rows, with E4 at rest and on focus.
  - No Next up words on the glass: they live in the Plans cell's first row.
  - Deck as the base bezel (From, 'Send where I am', mic, Send as E3). Then three '→' starter keys at 44px. Then 'Continue with Vera →' on the case foot.
  - E7: pool on the case lip and a 60-80px spill onto the page.
  - Phone: the radar at 7rem at the glass's top right, the question full width on one line at about 2.1rem, the well at 3 rows.
- LEFT, IDEAS (300): contents line with '12 saved', 'Lately added', four rows (kind icon and word in the kind's colour), foot with Restaurants and Add an idea.
- RIGHT, THE SERVICE LINE (feature 1), then PLANS (400) with five date-cell rows (feature 2), then TO DO (500: 'Who' and 'Due' heads, ticks with 44px hits, amber 'was due …' words).
- FOOT STRIP, the sommaire's household pages as contents lines side by side, `display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap`, each at least 16rem, each 2.75rem with one sub-line:
  - 600 Wishes ··· 0 open (Maya 0 · Theo 0)
  - 700 Memory ··· → (+ Tell Vera something)
  - 800 Family ··· 4 people (initial tiles)
  - 900 Status ··· 1 on · 2 off (● Answering ○ Telegram ○ Calendar)
  - 990 Settings ··· 9 parts · 1 needs a look (amber), with 'Sign-in and security' as its link
  - The lamp key once, at the strip's end.
  This replaces five boxes and ends the stretched cells.

INNER PAGES: as in the fixes above, and the wiring (feature 3) everywhere.
- Plans List (plans.html): each row led by the same date cell as Home.
- Plans Month: day numerals at 1.25rem Plex Sans Condensed 500, tabular. Days with a plan get their numeral in sky 600, empty days in dim, and today in phosphor with a lamp and the steel ring, so the month speaks the same numerals as Home. Its head screen: 'SEPTEMBER 2026', 'This weekend, 3–4 Oct: Oaks Park roller rink' and, if the weeks give it, 'Next free weekend: 10–11 Oct', in words.
- Ideas' head screen: the places radar at 8.5rem, with '10 of 12 placed', 'Nearest …' and 'Furthest …' from places_radar.
- To do's head screen: the bars in two columns with 'NEXT DUE'.
- Status' head screen: the spend in words and the ASCII bar.
- Settings: plate only, then the parts register without numbers, needs-a-look first.
- Chat: composer glass line and Send on one row, From and the mic on the lip.
- Form: labelled contents lines (9rem label column and field).

THE FOUR GRAFTS, rebuilt in the switchboard's own terms:

1. THE SERVICE LINE (L042, with L270's middle way). The setup cell becomes one contents line at the top of the right column, the videotex 'line 0' where the service posts its notices:
   - An amber bar lamp, 'Finish setting up' (cell-head 600 at --t-cell), the leader, '3' as a 1.5rem condensed amber figure with 'left' in dim.
   - A second line: 'Next: Choose your own password →' as the one prominent link (17px, underlined), then 'then Telegram, then Google Calendar' as two short 44px links.
   - At the right, an 'All 3 steps' key (44px) to /setup.
   - Slate body #121614 with a 3px amber left edge. No amber or bronze fill, no boxed digits. 7rem tall or less.
   It sits after the terminal in the DOM, so it never comes before the box.

2. PLAN DAYS AS DATE CELLS (L046), keyed to the radar by the same numerals (with L201).
   - Each Plans row, on Home and on the Plans list, is led by a 3.25rem designator slot: the day numeral in IBM Plex Sans Condensed 400 at 1.875rem (30px), tabular lining, in the plans sky. Beside it the weekday over the month, stacked in 12px Plex Mono 500 sentence case ('Thu' over 'Oct') in --label. Then the title (19px 600), the leader, the time in Plex Mono and 'in 4 days' in sky words (no box, no caps).
   - Rows at least 3.25rem, hairline between.
   - The FIRST row is Next up: its numeral at the hot core with E1's halo, a breathing lamp in its slot's corner, and 'Next up' in 13px semibold sky before its title. A plan today also lights in phosphor, never amber.
   - The cell counts '5 coming' and lists all five, so nothing is said twice.
   - On the terminal's radar, each blip carries its row's day numeral: an SVG `<text>` in VT323 at 15 units, offset right of the blip, with `paint-order: stroke` in the glass colour; the next one's numeral hot. `views.radar_blips` returns blips in the order of `coming`, so key them with loop.index: `class='blip b{{bearing}} k{{loop.index}}'`, rows `k1`…`k8`.
   - Pointing at or focusing a row lights its blip in 0.12s: a `.lit` layer with the halo at 0.6, core #e4fff0 and a ping ring, fading over 1.2s. Use generated rules like `.map:has(.plan-rows .k3:is(:hover,:focus-within)) .blip.k3 .lit { opacity: 1 }`.

3. THE WIRING (L014). Each part's lines take its circuit's colour, as a switchboard's cords and jack fields are colour-coded:
   - `.cell, .page-head, .main, .side, .screen-cell { --wire: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sec) 30%, var(--line)); --wire-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sec) 45%, var(--line-2)) }`.
   - Every hairline in the part draws in them: the cell's 1px frame, the rule under the contents line, the row rules and column-head rule, and the dotted leaders (2px dotted, --wire-2).
   - The 2px coloured caps go, on Home and on the plates. The section colour now lives in the lines and the figures: Plans sky, To do teal, Ideas periwinkle, the household's pages bone. The setup line keeps only its amber edge, and 'here' keeps its steel cap.
   - Hold frames at 30% (above about 35% it turns to confetti) and leaders at 45%.

4. POINT AT A ROW, ITS MARK LIGHTS (L201). Built inside feature 2 on Home. Also, on the To do page, pointing at a row lights its bar's label on the head screen (Late, This week, No date) the same way, keyed by the task's bucket class.

LIGHT: the phosphor list as in the kit (E1-E7, E10, E12-E17, E19, E20). One glass on Home (the terminal) and one head screen per live inner page. Everything else is matte. Keep RM, MC and FC.

HARD CHECKS: no inline style, <style> or script; csrf and once tokens kept; no sprite icon dropped.

briefs.title:
Anything to *plan*? Untried in the tour. On a switchboard it is the operator's open line: the first thing she asks when she picks up, typed on the glass with a block cursor waiting after it, so it reads as the terminal's prompt.
- It is the family's own casual phrase, and an invitation to tell Vera anything. 'Anything' opens the box to a plan, an idea to keep or a reminder, and the placeholder beneath ('Plans for the weekend, an idea to keep, a reminder, the calendar…') reads as its answers.
- It lights the job word, 'plan', and only that word. Next up has left the glass, so no other glow sits beside it.
- It answers the skeptic's risk with 'What’s the plan?', that it asks the family for a plan they may not have: this asks only whether there is anything.
- At 17 characters it holds one line on a 390px phone in VT323 at about 2.1rem, and has no apostrophe for VT323's tall tick to spoil.
- It sits beside the refinement's 'What’s the plan?' so the judges can compare the two in the same lineage.
